description: Frontend fixes and review UX, all claims verified: 1.3 LanguagePage reads stats.vocabulary_count/pronunciation_attempts/conversations but backend writes total_vocab/pronunciation_sessions/conversation_sessions (home + progress); 1.6 speakPhrase hardcodes utterance.lang='en-US' and recognition passes raw codes (e.g. 'es'), copy hardcodes English; 1.7 after a review the index is incremented AND the refreshed due list drops the reviewed card, so every other card is skipped (same bug in useStudy.reviewCard); 1.8 refreshLanguage uses Promise.all; 6.8 StudyPage effect re-subscribes every render and never removes the anonymous dragover listener; item 9 PomodoroTimer: dead SVG CSS, '.pomodoro-container' CSS does not match the 'pomodoro-timer' class, conic-gradient pie, pause resets position, onComplete fired inside a setState updater (double-fires under React StrictMode in main.tsx). Plus 6.5 keyboard shortcuts, 2.5 undo UI, 2.6 UI (vocabulary list + delete with ConfirmDialog, 'Encerrar conversa', shadowing saved to its own endpoint). Depends on FEAT-002 (undo endpoints, next_due_at) and FEAT-003 (delete/shadowing/conversation endpoints).
steps: New frontend/src/utils/speechLang.ts: `speechLang(code?: string): string` mapping en->en-US, es->es-ES, fr->fr-FR, de->de-DE, it->it-IT, pt->pt-BR, ja->ja-JP, ko->ko-KR, zh->zh-CN, ru->ru-RU; codes already containing '-' returned as-is; empty -> 'en-US'. `languageName(code?: string): string` Portuguese names (en 'inglês', es 'espanhol', fr 'francês', de 'alemão', it 'italiano', pt 'português', ja 'japonês', ko 'coreano', zh 'chinês', ru 'russo'; fallback the code).

New frontend/src/hooks/useReviewShortcuts.ts: `useReviewShortcuts({ enabled, revealed, onFlip, onGrade, onUndo })` - one window keydown listener registered in useEffect with [enabled] deps, latest callbacks kept in a ref (no re-subscribe per render), cleanup removes the same function. Ignore events when e.defaultPrevented, e.altKey/e.metaKey, or target is input/textarea/select/[contenteditable]. Space/Enter -> onFlip (preventDefault); '1'..'4' -> onGrade(0..3) only when revealed; 'z' without modifiers or Ctrl+Z -> onUndo (if provided).

frontend/src/hooks/useLanguage.ts: refreshLanguage uses Promise.allSettled over dashboard, vocabulary/due, pronunciation and the full /api/language/vocabulary list; each setter runs only for a fulfilled response with res.ok (parse json inside a try). Whenever dueVocab is set from a refresh: setVocabIndex(0) and setVocabBackVisible(false) (the reviewed card leaves the list, so the next card is always index 0). reviewVocab: no index increment; on 400 notice 'Nota inválida.'; track `vocabUndoCount` (+1 per successful review). Add undoVocabReview(): POST /api/language/vocabulary/undo -> ok: refresh, then select the restored card (index of returned card.id in the new due list, fallback 0), show its front, decrement undo count, notice 'Revisão desfeita.'; 404 -> notice 'Nada para desfazer.' and reset count to 0; 409 -> notice 'Não foi possível desfazer: o cartão mudou ou foi excluído.'. Expose `nextVocabDueAt` from the due response. Add `vocabulary` state + deleteVocabulary(id): POST /api/language/vocabulary/{id}/delete -> refresh + notice 'Palavra excluída.'. startPronunciation(target, kind: 'pronunciation' | 'shadowing' = 'pronunciation'): recognition.lang = speechLang(dashboard?.target_language); for shadowing POST /api/language/shadowing {text: target, score, speed: 0.85} instead of /api/language/pronunciation. Add endConversation(): requires >=1 user message; POST /api/language/conversation {topic: first user message slice(0,80), corrections: 0, new_vocab: [], duration_minutes: whole minutes since the first message (track a langStartedAt timestamp when the first message is sent)}; on ok clear langMessages/langSessionId/langStartedAt and notice 'Conversa registrada! +25 XP'. Return all new members.

frontend/src/hooks/useStudy.ts: refreshStudy sets studyCardIndex to 0 and cardBackVisible false whenever it sets dueCards; reviewCard no longer increments the index; on 400 notice 'Nota inválida.'; add studyUndoCount, undoReview() (POST /api/tutor/flashcards/undo, same 404/409 handling and restored-card selection as the language hook), nextCardDueAt from the due response. Do not change other functions. Return the new members; App.tsx destructures useStudy members explicitly and passes them to StudyPage - add the new ones there and to StudyPageProps.

frontend/src/pages/LanguagePage.tsx: use dashboard.stats.total_vocab / pronunciation_sessions / conversation_sessions (+ a 'shadowings' stat from shadowing_sessions on the progress tab); speakPhrase uses utterance.lang = speechLang(dashboard?.target_language); placeholders and copy use languageName(...) ('Palavra em {inglês}', 'Escreva em {inglês} ou português…', 'Converse em {inglês} com o tutor…'); vocab review: show key hints on grade buttons ('1 Errei', '2 Difícil', '3 Bom', '4 Fácil'), '↩ Desfazer' button (disabled when undo count is 0; title 'Desfazer última revisão (Z)'), call useReviewShortcuts({enabled: activeTab==='vocab' && !!currentCard, revealed: vocabBackVisible, onFlip, onGrade: reviewVocab, onUndo: undoVocabReview}); when no card is due but nextVocabDueAt is set show 'Próximo cartão em N min' and schedule a refreshLanguage at that time (clear timeout on unmount/change). Add 'MINHAS PALAVRAS' list under the add form (word — translation, small 'Excluir' button per row with aria-label 'Excluir {word}'); clicking opens components/ConfirmDialog (title 'Excluir palavra?', message '“{word}” e o agendamento de revisão serão removidos. O histórico de revisões continua nas estatísticas.', confirmLabel 'Excluir', danger) and confirm calls deleteVocabulary. Conversation tab: 'Encerrar conversa' button (disabled without user messages) calling endConversation. Shadowing record button calls startPronunciation(phrase, 'shadowing'). Remove the PomodoroTimer from the home tab (it moves to StudyPage). Add the new props to LanguagePageProps.

frontend/src/pages/StudyPage.tsx: replace the paste/drop effect with handlers defined INSIDE one useEffect with deps [activeMode]; read props callbacks (readEnemImage, setNotice) through a ref updated every render; named `handleDragOver` (always preventDefault, as today) removed in cleanup together with paste and drop (behavior preserved). Review panel: key-hint labels, '↩ Desfazer' button bound to props.undoReview, useReviewShortcuts({enabled: activeMode==='review' && !!currentCard, revealed: cardBackVisible, ...}), 'Próximo cartão em N min' + timed refresh like LanguagePage. Mount ONE PomodoroTimer permanently (outside the conditional panels) inside .study-main wrapped in <div className="study-pomodoro-dock">, onComplete for now shows notice 'Pomodoro concluído! Hora de uma pausa.' (FEAT-005 wires XP).

frontend/src/components/study/PomodoroTimer.tsx: state = phase ('work'|'shortBreak'|'longBreak'), running:boolean, secondsLeft, phaseTotal. Ticking: when running, keep a deadline ref (Date.now() + secondsLeft*1000) and a 500 ms interval that sets secondsLeft = max(0, ceil((deadline-Date.now())/1000)); completion handled in a separate useEffect watching secondsLeft===0 && running, guarded by a ref so onComplete(finishedPhase, minutes) fires exactly once per phase even under StrictMode, then advances phase (work -> short/long break every 4th, break -> work), sets phaseTotal/secondsLeft and keeps running. Buttons: idle -> 'Iniciar'; running -> 'Pausar' and '+5 min' (adds 300 to secondsLeft and phaseTotal); paused (not running, secondsLeft < phaseTotal) -> 'Continuar' and 'Reiniciar' (back to work, full time, not running). Render an SVG ring: <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" width=100 height=100><circle className="pomodoro-track" cx=50 cy=50 r=45/><circle className="pomodoro-progress" cx=50 cy=50 r=45 strokeDasharray={C} strokeDashoffset={C*(1-progress)}/></svg> with progress clamped 0..1, plus the existing .pomodoro-inner time/label. Settings edits apply when not running (reset secondsLeft/phaseTotal for the work phase). aria-label on the ring ('Tempo restante mm:ss').

frontend/src/styles.css (Pomodoro block ~line 5146): rename `.pomodoro-container` selector to `.pomodoro-timer`; make .pomodoro-inner a column (time + label); add .pomodoro-time, .pomodoro-label, .pomodoro-count, .pomodoro-settings-btn styles; add .study-pomodoro-dock (position:absolute; left:12px; bottom:12px; z-index above canvas, compact padding) and a narrow-screen rule. Add small styles for the review key hints, undo button, vocabulary list rows and next-card hint, reusing existing colors (#111117, #393944, var(--jarvis-cyan)).
frontend/src/types.ts: add `state?`, `step?`, `last_review?`, `retrievability?` to VocabCard and Flashcard (Flashcard currently only id/front/back).
Run tsc + build; fix type errors. Commit (stage by name): `fix(estudos): corrige campos, voz, fila de revisão, listeners e Pomodoro; atalhos e desfazer`.
acceptance_criteria: Language Progress/home tabs show real values from total_vocab, pronunciation_sessions, conversation_sessions.
TTS and STT use the BCP-47 tag of the target language.
Reviewing walks through every due card in order (no skipping); undo restores and shows the previous card.
Keys: Space/Enter flip, 1-4 grade after reveal, Z/Ctrl+Z undo; ignored while typing.
StudyPage registers paste/drop/dragover once per activeMode change and removes all three on cleanup.
Pomodoro pause/resume keeps phase and remaining time, ring renders via SVG, onComplete fires once.
Vocabulary can be deleted after confirmation in ConfirmDialog; conversations can be logged; shadowing goes to /api/language/shadowing.
tsc and npm run build pass; mobile_app unchanged.
findings: Commit 82c1f73 on main. Verification: tsc --noEmit clean, npm run build OK, frontend/tests/broken-text.cjs exit 0, git status --short mobile_app empty. (A git auto-gc 'Unlink of file .git/objects/pack/...idx failed' prompt hung after the commit again; the commit succeeded. `git -c gc.auto=0 commit` did not prevent it, because another process has the pack file locked.) NEW FILES: frontend/src/utils/speechLang.ts (speechLang(code?) -> BCP-47, languageName(code?) -> pt-BR name, fallback 'inglês' when empty); frontend/src/hooks/useReviewShortcuts.ts (useReviewShortcuts({enabled, revealed, onFlip, onGrade, onUndo?}); Space/Enter flip, 1-4 grade 0..3 only when revealed, z / Ctrl+Z undo; ignores defaultPrevented, alt/meta, input/textarea/select/contenteditable); frontend/src/hooks/useNextDueRefresh.ts (useNextDueRefresh(nextDueAt, active, refresh) -> minutes until due or null; schedules refresh at due+1s, 30 s ticker for the label). useLanguage NEW MEMBERS: undoVocabReview(): Promise<void>, vocabUndoCount: number, nextVocabDueAt: string|null, vocabulary: VocabCard[] (GET /api/language/vocabulary .cards), deleteVocabulary(id): Promise<void>, endConversation(): Promise<void>; startPronunciation(target, kind: PronunciationKind = 'pronunciation') (exported type PronunciationKind = 'pronunciation'|'shadowing'); refreshLanguage now returns Promise<VocabCard[]|null> (the new due list) and uses Promise.allSettled. useStudy NEW MEMBERS: undoReview(): Promise<void>, studyUndoCount: number, nextCardDueAt: string|null, refreshStudy (now exported, returns Promise<Flashcard[]>). App.tsx destructures undoReview, studyUndoCount, nextCardDueAt, refreshStudy and passes them to StudyPage; language props still go through languageProps={{...language, setNotice}} (so any new useLanguage member reaches LanguagePage automatically). StudyPageProps NEW: undoReview, studyUndoCount, nextCardDueAt, refreshStudy: () => Promise<unknown>. LanguagePageProps NEW: undoVocabReview, vocabUndoCount, nextVocabDueAt, refreshLanguage: () => Promise<unknown>, vocabulary, deleteVocabulary, endConversation; startPronunciation(target, kind?). FOR FEAT-005 TO WIRE: (1) PomodoroTimer props unchanged: onComplete?: (phase: PomodoroPhase, minutes: number) => void, exported type PomodoroPhase = 'work'|'shortBreak'|'longBreak'; minutes = Math.round(phaseTotal/60) of the finished phase (includes '+5 min' extensions; settings allow work 1..90 min, so FEAT-005 must only POST /api/study/pomodoro for phase==='work' && minutes within 5..90). Fires once per phase (cycle-ref guard), never inside a setState updater. The single PomodoroTimer is mounted in StudyPage.tsx inside <div className="study-pomodoro-dock"> at the end of .study-main with onComplete={() => props.setNotice('Pomodoro concluído! Hora de uma pausa.')} - replace that callback with the XP call (e.g. a new StudyPage prop like onPomodoroComplete). LanguagePage no longer renders a PomodoroTimer. (2) No XP/level/badge UI exists yet; after review/undo/conversation/shadowing the hooks only refresh their own data (refreshStudy / refreshLanguage), so a study dashboard hook must be refreshed separately. (3) The conversation notice text is hardcoded 'Conversa registrada! +25 XP'. CSS added in styles.css after the Pomodoro block: .pomodoro-timer (renamed from .pomodoro-container), .pomodoro-time/.pomodoro-label/.pomodoro-count/.pomodoro-settings-btn, .study-pomodoro-dock (absolute left/bottom 12px, z-index 9 < overlay 10; on <=760px moves to top:56px scaled .8), .review-key, .review-footer, .review-undo, .review-next-due, .lang-vocab-list/.lang-vocab-row, .lang-end-conversation. Review panels: grade buttons contain <kbd className="review-key">N</kbd> + label (text e.g. '1 Errei'), '↩ Desfazer' button has class review-undo and title 'Desfazer última revisão (Z)'; empty states now say 'Nenhum flashcard pendente agora.' / 'Nenhum vocabulário pendente para revisão agora. 🎉' followed by 'Próximo cartão em N min' (.review-next-due) when next_due_at is set. Vocabulary delete row buttons have aria-label 'Excluir {word}'; ConfirmDialog renders inside the LanguagePage root (.study-overlay-panel) with title 'Excluir palavra?'. Shortcuts in LanguagePage are disabled while the delete dialog is open. types.ts: new ReviewState type; Flashcard and VocabCard gained state?, step?, last_review?, retrievability? (VocabCard stability/difficulty now number|null). INTEGRATION CHECK (convergence fixer, iteration 1, no review.json, HEAD 514549c): python -B -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --tb=short <the 14 files of context.json test_command> -> exit 1, 268 passed, 2 failed (only the known pre-existing tests/test_tool_catalog.py personal_records failures, out of scope); node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json exit 0; npm run build exit 0; Vite on 127.0.0.1:5174 (Start-Process, stopped afterwards) + node tests/study.smoke.cjs exit 0 with 8 PASS lines and the 5 screenshots refreshed; node tests/broken-text.cjs exit 0; git status --short mobile_app empty; data/study absent before and after pytest. Manual seam review found no mismatches: /api/study/dashboard and /api/study/stats vs StudyDashboardData/StudyStatsData; due (cards+next_due_at), review, undo ({ok,card,undone_review_id}, 404/409), vocabulary list (.cards), delete, shadowing and conversation endpoints vs useStudy/useLanguage; language dashboard stats keys (no frontend reads of the stale stats.* XP keys); one shared StudyXP instance for the orchestrator TutorStore/LanguageStore and api/dashboard.py TutorStore() (get_study_xp cache by resolved path). No code changes and no commit were needed.
